caption: The drawing depicts a rural scene with several objects and features. In the foreground, a woman dressed in a long tan gown is standing on a curved dirt path, holding a basket, surrounded by three white sheep grazing on a grassy green area. To the right of the woman is a light-colored house with a brown thatched roof and a single window visible, along with green bushes near the base. Two large trees with green foliage, one in the center and another to the left, frame the scene; the leftmost tree has red fruits on its branches. In the background, a blue river flows horizontally across the image, with a curved footbridge visible on the left side connecting grassy banks. Beyond the river, a white small structure with a dark roof is near a hill, and further back is another building with a reddish roof situated on a hilltop among more green trees and brush. The sky is colored in light blue with white and gray clouds. The entire composition is bordered by a loosely stitched outline, and the colors predominantly include greens, blues, tans, browns, and whites.
title: Embroidered Picture
